authorship: LLM-authored retrieval proposals. Wikidata identifiers and retrieved statements remain untrusted inputs until canonicalized and checked.

seed_qids.hypothesis: Succinct data structure should connect to the broader data-structure concept in the bounded graph.
Disjoint-set data structure should expose type or subclass evidence.
Deterministic algorithm should connect to algorithm and determinism concepts.
Formal methods should connect to logic, mathematics, or verification concepts.
Deontic logic should connect to modal or philosophical logic.
A-star search should connect to algorithmic search concepts.
Algorithmics should connect algorithms and data structures.
Non-monotonic logic should connect to mathematical or non-classical logic.
Formal verification should connect to verification and correctness concepts.

goal_proposals.hypothesis: A retrieved path to data structure can discharge a bounded classification decision.
A retrieved path to algorithm can discharge a bounded algorithm-class decision.
A retrieved path to modal logic can support a bounded deontic-logic classification decision.
A retrieved path to formal logic can support a bounded logic-family decision.
A retrieved path to mathematics can support a bounded formal-methods context decision.

hypotheses: A bounded multi-relation crawl from these seeds will contain enough connected evidence for at least six required decisions.
Treating a statement as a navigable link does not license the inverse statement as a logical conclusion.
If a required evidence path is absent after truncation, the correct demo behavior is abstention rather than a negative real-world claim.

quarantined_proposals.proposal: Treat every retrieved edge as a verified real-world fact.
quarantined_proposals.reason: Retrieval supplies attributed knowledge-base statements, not an independent correctness proof.
quarantined_proposals.review_trigger: An external domain checker or curated source validates the relevant statements.

quarantined_proposals.proposal: Treat reverse graph navigation as an inverse logical implication.
quarantined_proposals.reason: A browsing edge may be traversed in either direction, while its predicate retains its original direction.
quarantined_proposals.review_trigger: A relation-specific inverse rule is explicitly supplied and verified.

quarantined_proposals.proposal: Interpret an absent path as proof that no relation exists.
quarantined_proposals.reason: Depth, node, property, degree, request, and freshness bounds make the snapshot incomplete.
quarantined_proposals.review_trigger: A complete closed-world source and coverage proof replace the bounded snapshot.
